description: Defines the Twig\Markup class, which is used to mark content as safe for output in Twig templates. The class implements interfaces for counting, JSON serialization, and string conversion, and manages content with an associated charset.

classes.name: Twig\Markup
classes.description: A class that marks a string as safe for rendering in templates, with capabilities for counting characters, JSON serialization, and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Markup object with content and charset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the content as a string.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset associated with the content.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the content based on the charset.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the content for JSON serialization.
